selection_reason: XGBoost had the highest validation ROC-AUC (0.799; ties broken by PR-AUC then recall). Selection never used test data. Decision threshold: highest threshold keeping validation recall >= 90% (validation specificity at this threshold = 0.434); chosen for screening where missed cases are costlier than false alarms.
